product.title: Barcelona City Tour: Gothic Pedrera, Sagrada Familia & Park Güell

description.text: Experience Barcelona City Tour: Gothic Pedrera, Sagrada Familia & Park Güell in Barcelona. Benefit from fast-track entry and an intimate tour of the famed Spanish architect’s most iconic works, including Park Güell and the UNESCO-listed apartment building La Pedrera. Stops include Gothic Quarter, Sagrada Familia, Park Güell, La Pedrera. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so visitors can focus on Gaudí architecture, Mediterranean views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
